votes.motion: To approve minutes from the June 14, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting as presented.

To approve application #CUP2020-000096 for St. Francis Xavier School is requesting an Extension for the Temporary Change to the original Conditional Use allowing for pick up and drop off along 4520 West, during the COVID-19 restriction period with staff recommendation noted exceptions. [OAM2021-000388]

To recommend approval of file #OAM2021-000388 proposing to proposal to amend the existing Floodplain Ordinance in Section 19.74 of the Kearns Municipal Code. This update will replace the existing Section 19.74 with new language that conforms with current State of Utah and FEMA requirements to the Kearns Metro Township Council.

To recommend approval of file #OAM2021-000391 on a proposal to amend Section 19.62.030 of the Kearns Municipal Code which would add Used Car Dealership to the Permitted Use table in the C-2 zone to the Kearns Metro Township Council.
